brief.goal: Implement LAN-accessible dashboard with pairing token authentication and self-signed HTTPS encryption (REQ-021, REQ-022)
constraints: Electron desktop app with Node.js backend
Must use existing Electron IPC patterns (contextBridge allowlist, handler registration)
Must follow team directives (immediate close on shutdown, platform-mocked tests)
Pairing token required for first connection
non_goals: No mobile native apps (iOS/Android) - LAN dashboard only
No multi-user / team features - solo consultant focus
No external SSL certificates - self-signed only
success_criteria: HTTP server serves dashboard to LAN devices
Pairing token required on first connection
Self-signed HTTPS enabled for encrypted LAN traffic
Phone/tablet can access dashboard via browser
Server shutdown handles connections gracefully (immediate close)

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the LAN dashboard with pairing + HTTPS, covering REQ-021 and REQ-022 acceptance criteria
Implement the HTTP server with pairing token and self-signed HTTPS
Review the implementation against the spec and success criteria
Fix the 3 spec compliance issues found in convergence review
Verify the fixes resolve all issues found in the first convergence review

specify.output: Feature specification written to specs/003-lan-dashboard-https/spec.md covering REQ-021/REQ-022 with full technical design, security requirements, and test plan

implement.output: Implemented LAN server with TLS cert generation, pairing token auth, session cookies, static file serving, and HTTPS. 83 tests pass (40 new), typecheck clean, 3 pre-existing lint errors only

converge.output: Found 3 spec compliance issues: (1) Rate limiting counts successful sessions not failed attempts, (2) Missing query param auth support, (3) getToken() returns placeholder. No non-goals violations. All CDRs compliant.
issues: Rate limiting ineffective - counts successful sessions not failed attempts
Missing token auth via query param (?token=<token>)
getToken() returns placeholder '***' - token display impossible

implement_fixes.output: Fixed all 3 issues: (1) Rate limiting now tracks failed attempts per IP in token_attempts table, (2) Pairing endpoint supports both POST body and query param, (3) getToken() returns actual stored token via token_plaintext column. Added 2 new migrations. 83 tests pass.

converge_final.output: All 3 fixes verified. 40/40 tests pass. TypeScript typecheck clean. One security design tradeoff noted: token_plaintext stored in SQLite for display purposes (accepted tradeoff). All success criteria met. All CDRs compliant. No non-goals violations.
